messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "may mix liquid with water, milk, baby formula, fruit juice, or ginger ale"
set: ["may mix liquid with water, milk, baby formula, fruit juice, or ginger ale", "mix with small amount of applesauce, apple juice, or water", "mix with 4 ounces (half a cup) of water, ginger ale, lemon or lime soda, lemonade, or orange juice", "mix granules with baby formula or breast milk", "do not mix with any other liquid", "mix with infant formula", "mix with apple juice", "mix with apple sauce", "must mix powder with water", "mix capsule with water or infant formula only", "mix powder form with at least 4 ounces (one-half cup) of cold water or fruit juice before taking", "mix the medicine with soft food", "mix with an undesirable, nontoxic substance", "mix tablet with 1 or 2 teaspoons of water", "you may mix the concentrated solution with juice or a soft food such as applesauce", "mix granules with applesauce, mashed carrots, rice, or ice cream"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "mix with small amount of applesauce, apple juice, or water",
    "mix with 4 ounces (half a cup) of water, ginger ale, lemon or lime soda, lemonade, or orange juice",
    "mix granules with baby formula or breast milk",
    "mix with apple juice",
    "mix with apple sauce",
    "mix with infant formula",
    "mix with soft food",
    "you may mix the concentrated solution with juice or a soft food such as applesauce",
    "mix granules with applesauce, mashed carrots, rice, or ice cream"
  ],
  "alias": "mix with water, milk, baby formula, fruit juice, or ginger ale"
}
